ITA-5.59.14 dadru-kuṣṭhaḥ दद्रु-कुष्ठः
Skin disease with small, raised skin lesions
A chronic skin disease characterized by lesions associated with an itching sensation; reddish nodules; papules/eruptions; raised ring-shaped plaque; spreading out; resembling Indian doab grass; resembling flax flowers.
